name: dubai_changing_bgcolors
title: Dubai skyline, changing background colors
description: Equirectangular stereo (top-bottom 3D) 360° video of a Dubai skyline at sunset where the background sky is animated through a wide hue/chroma range. Worst-case for static-label methods that pick a single farthest color — the background sweeps past every CEC.

label_region.note: Single rectangular 'entering' label in the lower-left quadrant of the frame. Mask is a binary PNG; foreground pixels (value > 127) are the label area.
